owner_note.text: Read-aloud now drops anything the mic hears that matches what it is reading, and ignores near-silent audio. It also drops Whisper's phantom lines like "Thank you." when they arrive alone. So its own voice should no longer stop a reply or write a fake line. A short thinking cue is being built next, and you can turn it off with `thinking_cue: false`.
